propositions: Link-sync tests exercise only a single representative relation (blocks) instead of the full relation vocabulary, leaving multiple unmapped relations (depends_on, relates_to, duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) untested.
The outbound _diff_links emission must be parametrized over all 6 relations to assert correct (jira_type, swap) tuples for mapped relations and empty mutation lists for unmapped relations.
The outbound depends_on relation requires swap=True orientation handling, which must be explicitly asserted to prevent regression of the c8ed bug.
The link removal sync path contains an untested branch for outward-Blocks links whose local depends_on dependency was removed, requiring a new REMOVE test case.
Test-only changes with no production behavior modifications are required to close semantic round-trip gaps in the link-sync seam.
